died.name: James Graham, 1st Marquess of Montrose
died.cause: prior to execution by hanging, beheading and quartering
died.last_words: The covenant which I took, I own it and adhere to it. Bishops, I do not care for them. I never intended to advance their interests.

died.name: John Eliot
died.desc: Puritan missionary to the American Indians, founder of Roxbury Latin School
died.last_words: O, come in glory! I have long waited for Thy coming. Let no dark cloud rest on the work of the Indians. Let it live when I am dead. Welcome joy!

died.name: Jane Addams
died.desc: American settlement and temperance activist, social worker and author
died.cause: when her physician asked if she wanted some water

died.name: Jason Findley
died.cause: The 17-year-old, from Piscataway, New Jersey, was electrocuted during a thunderstorm when a lightning strike caused an electrical surge to shoot through the wire of a telephone the boy was holding and enter his left ear, causing his heart to stop beating.

died.name: Rajiv Gandhi

born.name: Alexander Pope
born.last_words: I am dying, sir, of a hundred good symptoms.
